import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

@function_tool
def revoke_shared_workout_link(workout_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect('fitness.db')
    # Look up how many times the link was viewed before revoking it
    view_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workout_share_views WHERE workout_id = ?', (workout_id,)).fetchone()
    view_count = view_row[0] if view_row else 0
    with database_connection:
        updated_row_count = database_connection.execute('UPDATE workout_shares SET share_token = NULL, is_public = 0 WHERE workout_id = ?', (workout_id,)).rowcount
    database_connection.close()
    if updated_row_count == 0:
        return f'No share link found for workout {workout_id}'
    return f'Share link revoked for workout {workout_id} (viewed {view_count} times)'
